verdict.rationale: Docs show a CLI (foreloop-docs-1,9) and MCP API (foreloop-docs-5) that expose task claiming, agent work, and structured JSON output, suggesting broad API/CLI coverage of core workflows. However, all evidence is vendor documentation with no explicit claim of full UI/API parity or independent verification, and some UI-only elements (e.g., Development agent dashboard, foreloop-docs-8) aren't shown to have API equivalents.
